cohort: Two hundred antenatal women at term with amniotic fluid index (AFI) less than 8cms.
finding: Oligohydramnios is associated with a high rate of pregnancy complications and increased perinatal morbidity and mortality.
mod_finding: 30% of patients with oligohydramnios underwent cesarean section, with fetal distress, CPD, malpresentations, failed induction, and deep transverse arrest being contributing factors.
birth_weight: Ranges from 1-2 kg (20%), 2-3 kg (50%), to >3 kg (30%).
gest_age: Primarily 37 to 42 weeks of gestation (80% between 37-40 weeks, 20% between 40-42 weeks).
